Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

SplitAlignerR 0.0.2

  • Prepared the package as a public seed release for the SplitAligner R reference implementation track.
  • Reframed the README and package metadata around bundled Catnip10 graph-oracle benchmark data, audit-ready accessors, and validation helpers.
  • Added catnip10_summary_counts(), validate_catnip10_oracle(), catnip10_fusion_groups(), and catnip10_matrix().
  • Removed placeholder software DOI metadata and private local paths from public-facing source files.

SplitAlignerR 0.0.1

  • Initial package scaffold (v0.0.1-scaffold).
  • Bundled the deterministic Catnip10 10-tip coordinate-audit benchmark expected oracle outputs (unrooted axis, both the global and local deletion regimes) as the catnip10_oracle data set, with the catnip10_expected() accessor.
  • Added splitalignerR_scaffold() placeholder so the package installs and passes R CMD check.
  • Set up GitHub Actions R-CMD-check continuous integration.
  • The split-based branch-mapping engine is not implemented yet.
